outcome.failureOutput: WHOBROKEIT_BUG: expected the "*" action not to run when no command is given, but it ran and received a command value

explanation.why: In `Command.prototype.parseArgs` in `index.js`, commit 28ff02a added an unconditional `emit('command:*')` for the case where no arguments are given. That emit exists so a program-level `.action()` runs without a command. A program-level action registers its listener on the `command:*` event. A subcommand explicitly named `'*'` registers its listener on the same event. So the new emit also fires the `'*'` catch-all subcommand when the user typed no command. Before the commit, that catch-all ran only when an unmatched command name was given.
